name: Utah Cubing with Culture 2024
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
